name: retrieval
title: Temporal hybrid retrieval

config.dense: local lexical vectors (hashed words + char trigrams) — no embedding key at build time

notes: Stale-clause rate = share of the top-3 results whose version was not in effect on the governing date (order date for returns/shipping/damage, claim date for billing/goodwill/approvals).
No embedding API key was available, so 'dense' is a local lexical vector, not a semantic embedding; it is labeled as such everywhere.
The agent additionally pins the rules.json clauses for each triaged intent; that is NOT counted here — this measures ranking alone.
